title: Quantization-aware prefetch and straggler analysis for embedding endpoint tail reduction
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: Embedding endpoint p99 has regressions under mixed tenancy due to quantized kernel fallback and sporadic warmup misses. This ticket scopes experiments and implementation to reduce tail latency by combining quantization-aware prefetching (warm KV/cache,state for quantized kernels), micro-batch shaping, and targeted kernel tunings.

Goal: Reduce embedding endpoint p99 by >=35% and p95 by >=20% on production-like traffic mix without increasing cost per 1M tokens by >5%.

Approach:
- Data collection: add fine-grained traces (queue wait, kernel selection time, quant-decode overhead) to per-request spans and dashboards.
- Prefetching: implement a quantization-aware prefetcher that warms KV/weights for likely upcoming model variants when requests are batched with quantized models. Bind prefetch policy to tenant fingerprints to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Micro-batching: introduce a dynamic micro-batch shaper that offers three modes (aggressive, conservative, adaptive) based on ingress QPS and SLO headroom.
- Kernel tuning: experiment with per-model kernel hints (matmul tile sizes, fused-softmax variants) with an opt-in runtime flag and low-risk canary rollout.
- Straggler mitigation: add speculative duplicate dispatch for requests that exceed a soft-deadline and monitor correctness/cost tradeoffs.

Instrumentation and metrics:
- New dashboard charts: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, kernel-selection latency, prefetch hit/miss rates, quant decode CPU, speculative retries, cost delta.
- Collect sampling traces for 1% of requests with full kernel-level profile and heap usage.

Experiments and rollout:
- A/B experiments on 3 canaries (low/med/high QPS tenants) for each micro-batching mode and kernel hint set.
- If p99 improves >=20% in canaries without error-rate increase, expand to 25% of traffic, then gradual to stable.

Risks and mitigation:
- Overshooting prefetch causes CPU/GPU memory pressure: implement tenant-level quotas and LRU eviction for prefetch caches.
- Quant-decoding regressions affecting quality: add unit tests and a quality regression harness using existing reranking eval sets.
- Increased cost from speculative retries: cap speculative rate and monitor cost per request.

Success criteria:
- Production p99 reduction >=35% within 6 weeks of rollout to stable.
- No more than 1.5x increase in error rate or model output quality regressions as measured by reranking evals.
- Cost per 1M tokens delta <= +5%.

Deliverables:
- Tracing + dashboard PRs
- Runtime flag and kernel hint config
- Prefetcher implementation + unit tests
- Micro-batch shaper with mode selection
- Canary rollout plan and monitoring runbook
